story: Tech feature demo 20 s: ONE feature = it keeps playing in the rain. Problem -> feature -> result, brand in the first 2 s. Add music and logo in the edit; it must play through the whole ad.
storyboard_prompts: Image 1 is the product photo: use exactly this product, its shape, materials, colours and logos. Create ONE storyboard image made of a 2x2 grid of four equal photo panels, edge to edge, with no borders, no gaps, no text and no numbers. Shot on a 35mm film camera, Kodak Portra 400, visible film grain, slight halation around highlights, natural unretouched colours, a real photograph, not a render. Product commercial, 9:16 vertical frame, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field. The speaker in every panel: a cylindrical portable bluetooth speaker wrapped in teal woven fabric, rounded teal rubber end caps, a small red rectangular JBL badge in the middle of the fabric, and a braided teal carrying strap. Panel 1 (top left): HOOK: macro of heavy raindrops hitting the teal fabric around the red JBL badge, droplets bouncing up off the fabric. Panel 2 (top right): PROBLEM: a sunny backyard party table suddenly hit by rain; friends seen from the chest down only, wet T-shirts and arms with real skin; nobody looks at the camera grab plates and run; the speaker stands on the table among cups. Panel 3 (bottom left): FEATURE: the speaker alone on the soaked wooden table in pouring rain, water streaming off its rubber end caps, puddles around it. Grey summer rain, wet surfaces, cool soft daylight from above, dark shadows under the table. Panel 4 (bottom right): PICK UP: a wet hand lifts the speaker by its braided strap, water dripping from it. The speaker has the same shape, size and colour in every panel; it is about as long as a forearm. Candid, unretouched photographs with natural imperfections: real crumbs, dust, fingerprints, uneven light, slight lens vignetting. No extra products, no added text, no watermark.
